name: subset_offline_8_rounds
deviations: Paper page 16 Appendix E explicitly uses Products subset pretraining and offline PPR. This corrects the old all-node-per-epoch reconstruction.

Exact author subset size/selection, PPR alpha/epsilon and mixing are unreleased. Fixed pool sizes here are reconstruction choices; restricting Goodreads-LP/Cloth pools is an additional 24-hour laptop capacity adaptation.
Eight configured subset rounds, 1280 seed batches per round and 10240 total updates. Full-graph epochs are NOT claimed.
All selected PPR neighborhoods are prepared before optimization. Induced union topology is still assembled per batch; complete offline edge blocks are not asserted.
Author model/width/experts/objective/LR/dropout retained; gradient clipping 1.0 and Windows/cu118 remain explicit engineering adaptations.
No labels select pretraining pools; immutable full raw graphs/features and official downstream test sets remain intact.
